# Campus Connect

> A unified college ERP, student engagement, and collaboration platform — GPS QR attendance, lectures, gamified points, leaderboards, digital ID cards, announcements, and real-time notifications for higher education institutions.

Campus Connect helps colleges run daily operations (lectures, attendance, results, documents, timetables) while keeping students engaged through points, streaks, achievements, leaderboards, and a digital campus ID. It ships as an installable PWA with offline-friendly caching and native web push notifications.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview, features, and how Campus Connect modernises campus operations.
- [Book a Demo](/book-demo): Schedule a guided walkthrough for your institution. Fill in details and connect via WhatsApp.
- [Get Started / Onboarding](/onboarding): Onboard your college and configure campus modules.
- [Start](/start): Alternate entry point for institution onboarding.
- [Live Demo](/demo): Explore a sandbox view of the platform across student, faculty, and admin roles.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Campus Connect team for partnerships, demos, or support.
- [Help & Support](/help): Common questions and getting-started guidance.
